title: LINSEIS Messgeräte GmbH
content: LINSEIS Messgeräte GmbH is a German thermal analysis and thermophysical property instrumentation manufacturer. Its portfolio covers techniques such as DSC, TGA, STA, LFA, and related measurements used in advanced materials research and thermal performance evaluation. LINSEIS is relevant to aerogel development programs that require reliable thermal analysis and property testing during formulation, benchmarking, and process optimization.
